    AStarPathfinder
    A* Pathfinder — translated from AStarVisualizer.jsx
    Terrain cost contract (Node.getCost()): -1 → "DO NOT CROSS" — impassable 0 → free movement >0 → weighted cost (higher = costlier) 0invalid input: '<'xinvalid input: '<'1 → favored terrain
    Features: - Weighted terrain costs via Node.getCost() - Near-wall penalty (+0.5 g-cost) to prefer open space - 8-directional XZ movement (no corner-cutting) - Uneven terrain: each XZ move probes Y-1/Y/Y+1, accepting the first passable level (max 1 block step up/down per move) - Octile heuristic (admissible, 3-D) - Weighted A* (f = g + 1.5h) for greedy-but-reasonable search
